title: Explain-in-Plain-English exam questions with LLM-based grading
summary: Students explain the high-level purpose of code fragments in short natural-language exam responses. The proposed grading process asks GPT-4 to regenerate code from each explanation and runs instructor-authored unit tests, while the reported deployment used two teaching assistants and a rubric.

sources.title: Evaluating Large Language Model Code Generation as an Autograding Mechanism for "Explain in Plain English" Questions
sources.evidence_quote: A total of 6380 responses to 42 EiPE questions from past exams were subject to each of the three CGBG approaches.
